pricing_per_mtok_usd.label: ASSUMED: API list price for a Sonnet-class model, used only to express seat usage as an equivalent cost

baseline_hours.label: ASSUMED: effort for the same output without AI-DLC; set per team in .qz/config.json

staffing.label: Every role offshore; one onshore PMO or manager only when the client asks

workspace.label: Where projects are kept on the person's computer when the tools run in a cloud session. Change it per person with QZ_DEVICE_ROOT, or on a laptop with ~/.qz/workspace.json {"root": ...}

egress.label: Set web_fetch to "allowlist" in .qz/config.json and the agent asks before reading any site that is not in the policy's allowedHosts or in web_hosts. Cloud metadata addresses are always refused.
